title: Slim-Runway quickstart hero + contextual card set
creator: Riya Patel
description: Design a compact, horizontally-oriented 'runway' hero for the Quickstart landing that pairs a concise value statement with a deck of contextual cards and pre-baked product screenshots. Goal: replace large legacy hero with a slim, scannable module that reduces vertical space while surfacing three primary starter paths (API quickstart, SDK examples, Private deployment). Deliverables include high-fidelity Figma file with responsive variants, motion spec for small micro-entrance animations, a screenshots pack (desktop/tablet/mobile), and engineering-ready tokens/CSS guidance.
background: Our current quickstart hero uses tall illustrations and large screenshots which push the fold down on key landing pages. Analytics show a 12% drop-off on scroll-to-call-to-action for new signups. This ticket is part of the Onboarding Refresh initiative to shorten first-run paths and increase conversion to the 'Create API key' flow. We want a design that reads well across narrow hero heights (max 420px on desktop) and gracefully collapses to a stacked layout on narrow viewports.
acceptance_criteria: Figma file finalized with desktop/tablet/mobile variants and organized component instances
Three contextual cards (API, SDK, Private) with iconography, 1-line descriptor, primary CTA and secondary link exported as components
Screenshot pack: 1920x1080, 1280x720, 768x1024, 375x812 with appropriately mocked data and redwood console chrome
Motion spec for entry micro-animation (fade + subtle slide) with durations and easing tokens
Design tokens and CSS guidance provided as a single README (color, spacing, typography, motion tokens) for handoff
Accessibility: contrast >= 4.5:1 for primary text in hero and keyboard-focus states for card CTAs
Signed off by PM (Anika Chen) and Head of Design (Liam O'Connor) and uploaded assets to Drive folder
